page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.120xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 480 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8490H processors with an x86_64 architecture and a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 8192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 17.07 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. To support high-throughput data transfers, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 128 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

Given the massive memory capacity and high core count, this instance represents a high-density resource profile designed for large-scale enterprise applications. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring vast memory footprints where partitioning across multiple smaller nodes would introduce latency or synchronization overhead. Best-fit workloads include massive in-memory databases, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, real-time data analytics, and heavy enterprise resource planning systems.
